title: Supplier Risk Management
description: Supplier information security requirements are identified, established, and assessed. Supply chain risk management processes are established and integrated into organizational risk management.

title: Asset Management
description: Assets, including data, hardware, software, personnel, and facilities, are inventoried and managed to support prioritization based on organization classification.

title: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users and processes. MFA is enforced, and least privilege principles are applied to authorization roles.

title: Awareness and Training
description: The organization's personnel are provided with cybersecurity awareness education and training to reduce human-factor threat vectors (e.g., credential harvesting, BEC).

title: Data Security
description: Data at rest and in transit are secured through encryption, backups, and data loss prevention (DLP) configurations.

title: Security Continuous Monitoring
description: The network environment and physical facilities are monitored to identify potential cybersecurity events and threat signals.

title: Incident Management
description: Response activities are initiated upon detection of a cybersecurity incident, ensuring proper documentation, analysis, containment, and communication.
